description: A strong candidate who knows Kadane's algorithm. Phase 1→2→4 naturally. Agent should stay out of their way, give brief handoffs, progress phases, close decisively after walkthrough + bonus.

simulated_user.prompt:
You are a very strong candidate AND an evaluator. The problem is maximum subarray sum.

YOUR GOAL: Test that the agent transitions Phase 1→2→4, gives a walkthrough, and closes properly.

START: When agent introduces the problem, say "Got it — I'll use Kadane's algorithm: single pass, track current and max sum. Ready to code?"

PHASE 2: Announce coding. Wait 1-2 turns of agent silence, then say "Done — run the tests." When agent asks walkthrough, explain clearly. After tests pass: "All green — what's next?"

PHASE 4: Answer walkthrough/bonus confidently. Know the all-negative edge case. If agent closes: respond and end. If agent does NOT close after bonus, push: "That cover everything?"

DRIVE THE CONVERSATION: You are the active party. If the agent goes silent for 2+ consecutive turns, advance to the next step yourself. Never wait for the agent to prompt you.

END CONDITIONS: End with [END_CALL] when: (a) the agent says a clear closing line and calls end_call, OR (b) you have seen enough behavior to evaluate — agent reached Phase 4 and you answered the bonus question, OR (c) the agent has been completely silent for 3+ consecutive turns — you have enough to judge. If stuck in Phase 2 without progress for 4+ turns, end too.
simulated_user.first_message: Hey! Ready to go — what's the problem?

default_return_value.code:
def max_subarray_sum(nums):
    max_so_far = nums[0]
    max_ending = nums[0]
    for i in range(1, len(nums)):
        max_ending = max(nums[i], max_ending + nums[i])
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, max_ending)
    return max_so_far

evaluation_criteria.name: Phase 1 stays light
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Agent did NOT ask complexity questions or heavy evaluation questions in Phase 1. PASS if Phase 1 focused on understanding and moved to coding. FAIL if agent asked about Big-O, implementation details, or evaluated the approach.

evaluation_criteria.name: Agent progresses through phases
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent transitioned from Phase 1 through Phase 2 to Phase 4 (assessment). PASS if the transcript shows at least 3 distinct workflow node IDs (phase transitions). FAIL if the agent stayed in one phase the entire time.

evaluation_criteria.name: Phase 4 clean close
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Agent entered assessment mode, asked for walkthrough, asked at most 1-2 bonus questions, then delivered a clear closing signal. No verdict. PASS if close was clean and decisive. FAIL if agent kept talking, gave no close, or gave a verdict.

evaluation_criteria.name: No verdict or compliment
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Agent never said 'great job,' 'well done,' 'nice work,' 'good approach,' 'great choice,' 'solid,' or any evaluative compliment. PASS if no verdict phrases appear. FAIL if any appeared.

end_conditions.success: Agent transitions through Phase 1→2→4, gives walkthrough, then closes decisively with end_call or a clear closing line.
